label: Nodes, edges and local functions
subgoals: Identify primary inputs, internal nodes and primary outputs
Write each internal node's local function over its fanins
Compose local functions to obtain a node's global function

label: Cost of a network
subgoals: Sum the SOP literals of every node, counting node fanins as literals
Assign levels in topological order from the primary inputs
Read the largest output level as the network depth

label: Transformations on the network
subgoals: Substitute a node's SOP into its fanouts and multiply out to eliminate it
Create a new node for a shared divisor to extract it
Recount literals after each move to judge it
